name: Rise Again, Greater
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 9, shaman 9, white necromancer 9

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as rise again except it returns the target to full health and condition and can affect a creature who was destroyed as per the spell resurrection.
